comparison.objective: Screw a bulb into a stabilized lamp base and place its hood evenly; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual threaded bulb insertion and hood placement versus recessed setscrew unlocking, collar calibration, counterholding, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Bulb fully seated and hood even versus two acceptable carriage stops and retained adjustment; board setup and scoring are missing.
comparison.reason: Rotational manipulation is generic; threaded assembly does not test iterative dynamic tuning or a separately locked setting.
